blocks.text: The hidden cost of inefficient legal research

When your research process is fragmented, you lose more than just time. You lose confidence in the work you submit. Legal professionals often bill fewer than three hours per day, yet they spend much of their remaining time on non-billable, stressful research tasks. This gap contributes to long hours and high stress levels. When you spend extra time verifying citations or re-searching a case because you forgot where you saved the link, you are not just losing minutes. You are adding to your daily fatigue.
Why legal research is a constant challenge

The primary issue is the sheer volume of information. Paralegals must navigate massive databases of statutes, case law, and regulations while hitting tight deadlines. You are constantly balancing the need for speed with the ethical requirement for precision. The biggest trap is the 'good law' requirement. A general search engine cannot tell you if a case was overruled. Only specialized platforms can do that. Relying on the wrong tools for initial triage often leads to deeper, more time-consuming errors later in the drafting process.

items: Use authoritative platforms like Westlaw or LexisNexis for every final citation check.
Maintain a research journal. Record your search terms, the databases you checked, and the date of your search.
Separate your browser workspaces. Use profiles in Chrome or Safari to keep client matters isolated.
Use PDF tools like PDF Expert to annotate and highlight findings directly on the source documents.
Always verify firm policy before using any AI tool to summarize or redline legal documents.

blocks.text: How Lazur helps you research faster

Lazur lives in your Mac notch and helps you stay focused during long research sessions. When you are deep into a complex case, use your voice to manage the chaos. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about anything on your screen. You can ask for a summary of a page or where a specific button is in your case management software. Lazur does not click buttons for you, but it can guide you through the process step by step.

As a paralegal, your work involves sensitive data. Always prioritize your firm's security protocols over any efficiency gain. Lazur listens and looks at your screen only while you hold the shortcut. Your audio and screenshots are sent to AI providers to answer your questions and are not stored. Your content is never used to train models. If your firm prohibits certain AI tools, follow those rules strictly.

faq.question: Can Lazur perform legal research for me?
faq.answer: Lazur cannot conduct legal research or provide legal advice. It is a tool to help you organize your workspace, summarize notes, and guide you through your existing software.

faq.question: Is my data safe when using Lazur?
faq.answer: Lazur does not store your audio or screen data. It is processed only when you hold the shortcut key. Always check your firm's specific privacy policy regarding AI tools.
